page.layout: One printed page, title page. Text centred in lines from top to bottom; below the text an engraved emblem (tree, seated figure, banners reading TRAJECTI / SEMPER / CUSTA / HONOS ALIT ARTES); below the emblem the imprint in lines.

main_text.l: Juris in Acad. Ultraj. Prof. & Vian. Cam. Senat.
Juris Civilis tum Antiqui, tum Novi cum Divino, Forensi, Canonico & Feudali in multis collatio instituitur.

page.notes: The engraving shows a seated female figure beneath a tree, with banners reading "TRAJECTI" (partly "...LLAS" at left), "SEMPER" and "CUSTA"; described, not transcribed. The date is printed as "cIↄ Iↄ c LXVIII" with the reversed-C numerals, rendered as MDCLXVIII in the printed sense (1668). Imprint line "Ex Officinâ PAULI VINK, Bibliopolæ." is in small capitals for the printer's name.
